notes:
I couldn't do this research, so there are no notes. My first attempt to read the sources failed with a message saying the tool limit for this turn was already used up. Because of that, I wasn't able to open a single page: not Enduring Word, not the Bible Hub commentaries (Gill, Ellicott, Pulpit), not the NET Bible notes, and not Augustine on New Advent.

Your rules say to report only what the pages actually say and to give a URL for every point. I'm not going to write notes from memory instead. They wouldn't come from sources I'd read, and they couldn't have checked URLs.

If you send the request again, I'll start by reading these pages:
- **Traditional reading, verse by verse:** enduringword.com (Psalm 112); biblehub.com for Gill, Ellicott and the Pulpit Commentary; studylight.org; preceptaustin.org; Spurgeon's *Treasury of David* (on spurgeon.org or ccel.org)
- **Where Protestant traditions differ:** Wesley's notes (wesley.nnu.edu); Reformed sources (ligonier.org, thegospelcoalition.org); Lutheran sources (lcms.org, 1517.org)
- **Other views:**
  - Modern scholarship: netbible.org notes, for example on the alphabet-acrostic pattern and the "horn" in v. 9
  - Catholic and Orthodox: Augustine's exposition on newadvent.org (listed there as Psalm 111, its number in the Latin Bible); catholic.com
  - Prosperity teaching: gotquestions.org and similar sites, mainly on v. 3 ("wealth and riches")

You could also paste in text from any of these pages, and I'll write the notes from that.
